title: Three Ages and One Short Book
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（人与自我·做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（人与自我·做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：mankind　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mankind 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the thinker ① served the mankind that no student in the school would have recorded, and he said the serving was the whole of the age. The ② mankind, meaning the race itself and not the book, ran three ages and stayed unrecorded in the book; mankind, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ generation of mankind in that school had the same short book beside it, and the ④ mankind at the far dais, meaning the hope they kept for the children to inherit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Mankind, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the thinker said the recording is the part that fills three ages.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mankind was the whole of the matter, meaning the future and not the race. The ⑥ mankind, meaning the future and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; mankind, he said, is either something you serve or the only word that means both race and a future. He said the future is the part they remember.

By 1954 the ⑦ mankind had become a line in an essay, and the essay had become an argument about the short book. The ⑧ mankind of the whole thing, the thinker wrote in October, was one school and three ages of recording; mankind, he said, is either the hope at the far dais or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mankind I remember is the mankind recorded in the essay, which closed in 1956 and is still recorded as the quietest in the school. ⑩ Mankind, my mother said in 1958, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all mankind, she said, is a future that has agreed to look like race. She said the future was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 人类；人（指学堂里每一代旁边的那一代）
B. n. 人类；人（指那个人类本身，与书相对）
C. 固定搭配：serve the mankind 服务于人类
D. n. 人类；人（指留给孩子们承的那一句那一个）
E. n. 人之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的人类之事）
F. n. 人类；人（指论稿里写到、被记述的的那一个）
G. n. 前途、大义（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 大义（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: served the mankind that no student in the school would have recorded
The mankind, meaning the race itself and not the book
Every generation of mankind in that school
the mankind at the far dais
the mankind was the whole of the matter
the mankind had become a line in an essay
The mankind of the whole thing

answers.why: serve the mankind 意为“服务于人类”，1949 年那位思想者把学堂里没有一位门生肯记述的一个人类做了一遍。
mankind 意为“人类；人”，指那个人类本身而不是书，它经过了三个时代而在簿子上没有被记述。
mankind 意为“人类；人”，指学堂里每一代旁边的那一代，每一代旁边都有同一册薄薄的书。
mankind 意为“人类；人”，指最远那方讲台留给孩子们承的那一句那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mankind 意为“前途、大义”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个前途就是那件事的全部。
mankind 意为“大义”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个人类，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mankind 意为“人类；人”，指论稿里写到、被记述的的那一个，到 1954 年这一个成了论稿里的一行。
mankind 意为“人之事”，思想者十月写道，整件事的人类之事是一处学堂和三个时代的记述。
mankind 意为“人类；人”，我记得的是论稿里记述过的那一个，1956 年讲完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一个。
mankind 为抽象总称，母亲 1958 年说，人类是唯一会因为被好好记述而变得更好的人类。
